title: 15 June 2024 — cloud clearing
story: A cloud deck over Bedfordshire breaks up through the late morning (satellite cloudy fraction 74 % → 2 %). Satellite-derived PV at the 6 MW Leighton Buzzard 33 kV solar connection rises from about 1 MW to its 6 MW export limit.

title: 15 April 2024 — broken cumulus
story: Broken cumulus drifts across the region: PV is mostly high but drops sharply whenever a cloud shadow crosses the Leighton Buzzard solar connection.

title: 23 August 2024 — clear-sky control
story: A cloudless day: PV sits at its export limit, so every change in grid flow comes from load and the battery. This is the control case.
